moldura.Contradições, Atrocidades e Manipulação: Here the Bible is read in its entirety, with chapter and verse, without mockery and without hiding anything. To each point, also the answer that theologians usually give: the whole truth gives credibility. Reading the Bible in its entirety and in context does more than release loose verses chosen by the profiteer.
moldura.Atrocidades: ordenadas ou feitas por Deu: What the Bible text itself attributes to God or says that God commanded. That is what the text says; whether the facts happened is another question, and for many of them archaeology finds no sign.
moldura.Atrocidades: narradas como feitas por hu: Crimes that the Bible describes as being perpetrated by humans, without divine command. Often the text itself condemns them, as in the case of David and Uriah.
moldura.Mitos Derrubados: It gives to those who are hurting, in both senses: here fall religious, anti-religious and esoteric myths. The Solar Master serves no purpose; he serves the truth.
moldura.Caixa de Pandora: Opening Pandora's Box is looking straight at what history chose to forget. These are crimes of institutions and leaders, not of sincere believers. Knowledge of history protects, and the Church itself has acknowledged and apologized for many of these facts.
moldura.Técnicas de manipulação: These techniques appear in any group, religious or not, when power, unquestioned authority and fear come together. It is not a question of accusing anyone's faith, it is a question of recognizing the mechanism. Sources: the BITE model by Steven Hassan, the eight criteria by Robert Lifton, 1961, and the principles of persuasion by Robert Cialdini.
moldura.Arquivo: Igreja Católica: Historical archive, only with documented facts and figures with sources. These are crimes of institutions and leaders, not of sincere Catholics. The Church itself has asked forgiveness for many of them, as it did on Atonement Day 2000.
moldura.Arquivo: Igrejas Protestantes e Evangéli: Historical archive, with only documented facts. These are crimes of leaders and institutions, not of sincere evangelicals. Several denominations also acknowledged and apologized, such as the Southern Baptist Convention in 1995.
moldura.A Matrix Religiosa Hoje: A portrait of Brazil today, with sources and dates. It is not true of all churches: there are serious and welcoming communities. The pattern that matters is the power formula, more authority that can't be questioned, more fear. The accused is not convicted, and here each case tells you exactly where you stand.
moldura.Despertar da Matrix e Expansão de Consci: Here awakening is treated with honesty: what science has proven, what traditions teach and what no one knows yet, each with its own stamp. Awakening is not trading one belief for another; it's seeing your own mind at work, and then making a choice.
moldura.Neuroplasticidade: o cérebro que muda: The brain changes with what you repeat, learn, sleep and feel. Here's what science has proven, what's still hypothesis and what's market exaggeration, each with its own stamp. The good news is real, and it doesn't need a miracle.
moldura.O caminho do despertar: Here awakening is treated with honesty: what science has proven, what traditions teach and what no one knows yet, each with its own stamp. Awakening is not trading one belief for another; it's seeing your own mind at work, and then making a choice.
moldura.Metacognição: pensar sobre o pensar: Metacognition is the art of observing your own mind at work: what you know, what you think you know, and how you decide. Here are the most solid studies, the honest reviews and advanced practices, each with its own stamp. Awakening begins when the mind learns to see itself.
moldura.Trindade, inferno e o medo: Here we separate what is documented history, what is myth, what is faith and what is fear used to control. The Trinity and hell are sincere beliefs of millions of people; the Portal does not attack anyone's faith, it shows the history and who uses fear as a leash.
